title: Offline Sovereign Model Quantization & Inference via Apple MLX & GGUF
target_platform: Apple Silicon M1 (16GB Unified Memory) via Apple MLX (mlx-lm) & Ollama Metal
hypothesis: A 4-bit quantized 7B Qwen2 model running natively on Apple Silicon unified memory via Apple MLX (mlx-lm) achieves >= 35 tokens/sec within 6GB RAM on a 16GB M1 MacBook Pro, executing Protocol 128 orientation and basic code reviews offline with 0 API tokens and zero swap thrashing.
falsification_criteria: MLX 4-bit model consumes > 8GB unified memory causing macOS system swap, throughput drops below 20 tok/sec, or output hallucinates invalid Protocol 128 commands compared to base weights.
